contracts.title: Start a first useful session
contracts.outcome: A provider is connected and the user can submit the first request.

contracts.title: Resolve one attention item
contracts.outcome: The pending approval or question is answered with visible result state.

contracts.title: Switch to a known session
contracts.outcome: The selected session is visible without losing its draft or context.

contracts.title: Recover a disconnected connection
contracts.outcome: The connection recovers or the user receives a safe actionable failure.

contracts.title: Export a completed artifact
contracts.outcome: The selected artifact is saved to the user-approved destination.
